# Part 1.1: Creative Ideation

1. This course should include small group coding sessions during class because it encourages collaboration to learn new concepts. This benefits students who learn better through discussion and teamwork.
2. This course should include more practice problems with step-by-step solutions becqause it will help students build confidence and understand mistakes clearly. This would benefit students who are beginners in coding.
3. This course should include more real-life examples from media because most students spend significant time online. This benefits students who learn through approachable examples.
4. This course should include support systems specific to students in natural sciences in order to connect computer science to respective fields and see value in content learned in this class. This benefits students who are here due to prerequisites and feel unmotivated and don't see the point of the class. 
5. This course should include more example coding exercises asynchronously or during class because it encourages practice in practical code writing. This benefits students because most people are finding the exercises useful to their concept learning and code writing abilities.
